summary: Cass County, TX lookout tower listed as a Texas Forest Service site and marked gone; no build date, staffing or site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date in the sources read.

evidence.supports: Texas list places Union Hill in Cass County under the Texas Forest Service
Association table gives the coordinates and lists the tower as Gone
Survey datasheet names the site the Union Hill Lookout Tower
Datasheet places the survey mark on the USGS Sardis quadrangle
Datasheet has no description of the structure, so apart from the association's listing no source here describes the site today
Tennessee Landforms table places the tower in Cass County

sources.title: Union Hill - Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (centraluslookouts.weebly.com), reproducing a National Geodetic Survey datasheet

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: four list-style sources, and none gives a build date, staffing, fire history or a removal date. The only site-level source is the survey datasheet, which has no description. The story runs under the 120-word floor because the sources say no more; it was not padded. The brief record (gone, Cass, Texas Forest Service, coordinates) matches every source, so no corrections. Two warnings: the Central US Lookouts page texas1.html is about a Missouri lookout called Texas County, not this tower; and a Cass County Union Hill cemetery and church page turns up in searches but says nothing about a tower. Budget used: 2 WebSearch calls, 6 page reads.
